column1: # Game profile of ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 8 REMAKE (Switch, update v851968 = 1.1.3, with its four DLC). Plays on the Mac and on the iPhone
# Koei Tecmo's KTGL engine on NVN, SDK 17.5.3 (Ace Attorney Investigations Collection's SDK). Modules main + subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie: the WebM logo and story movies) + sdk.
# RomFS: a newer RDB than Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity's: 0002/root.rdb and system.rdb (indexes, with .rdx beside them) over 296 .fdata files named by KTID (a PDRK header, then
# IDRK entries) and 0002/data/*.file, 12.6 GB; each entry is LZ4 or zlib in 16 KB chunks (shader_split.py idrk_data). Scenarios, messages and movies sit in loose folders beside it.
# The update is a multi-program patch: beside the game's patch it carries a whole second program (title ID 0100C2A01A730001, 34 MB, its own control data), which main starts with
# nn::oe::ExecuteProgram(1) (main+0xa31910); the host runs only program 0 (nx_extract picks program index 0's NCAs)

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)

column2: ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 8 REMAKE

column1: # Menus and maps by D-pad or left stick; the dialogue boxes' auto and log buttons are the right stick and R3 (the 3D layout's). The game reads no touch screen (main imports no
# GetTouchScreenState), only a USB mouse, which the host does not provide
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): nninitStartup sets a heap of the pool − used memory (3.13 GB here). The 4 GB block of the other games without virtual
# address memory (256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region)
# The rewritten modules take more than the default 64 MB of used memory (Age of Calamity: 66.6 MB → 72 MB), which SetHeapSize checks the request against
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; KTGL G2S and _DOK containers in the RDB entries, GLSLC outputs in main) ----
